selection_principle: Named, source-checked examples covering research roles and distinct technical routes; not ranked or exhaustive.
line_semantics: Research classification only; no paper-to-paper inheritance is asserted.

known_source_issues.model-eeg-to-text-2022: Primary URL points to an unrelated video-deblurring paper; not re-linked.
known_source_issues.method-v-learning-2015: Title and DOI mismatch: DOI resolves to Zhao et al. dynamic-treatment-regime methods, not mHealth V-learning; link withheld.

milestones.label: CLOCS
milestones.caption: Contrastive cardiac representations across patients

source_checked.finding: ICML 2021; contrastive cardiac-signal views across space, time and patients.

milestones.note_optional: Retain registry year 2021. Signal-specific ECG representation milestone, not proof of deployment.
milestones.title: CLOCS: Contrastive Learning of Cardiac Signals across Space, Time, and Patients
milestones.evidence_boundary: This is representation or predictive-model evidence. It does not by itself establish a causal treatment effect, clinical benefit, safety, or regulatory readiness.

milestones.label: BENDR
milestones.caption: Contrastive EEG pretraining for task transfer

source_checked.finding: Published 23 June 2021; transformer-based contrastive self-supervision on EEG, followed by downstream transfer.

milestones.note_optional: Retain registry year 2021. EEG is one signal modality despite multiple channels and datasets.
milestones.title: BENDR: Using Transformers and a Contrastive Self-Supervised Learning Task to Learn from Massive Amounts of EEG Data
milestones.evidence_boundary: This is representation or predictive-model evidence. It does not by itself establish a causal treatment effect, clinical benefit, safety, or regulatory readiness.

milestones.label: HeartBEiT
milestones.caption: Masked ECG-image pretraining for diagnostic transfer

source_checked.finding: Published 6 June 2023; masked-image pretraining on ECG images, evaluated on three cardiac diagnostic tasks.

milestones.note_optional: Retain registry year 2023. Clinical ECG images are body-sensed-adjacent, not consumer-wearable validation.
milestones.title: A Foundational Vision Transformer Improves Diagnostic Performance for Electrocardiograms
milestones.evidence_boundary: This is representation or predictive-model evidence. It does not by itself establish a causal treatment effect, clinical benefit, safety, or regulatory readiness.

milestones.label: BIOT
milestones.caption: Unified tokenization for heterogeneous biosignal datasets

source_checked.finding: NeurIPS 2023; channel-wise tokenization enables cross-data learning across heterogeneous biosignal formats.

milestones.note_optional: Retain registry year 2023. Cross-data representation learning should not be captioned as simultaneous fusion of every listed modality. Registry primary_url was inaccessible; the verified official proceedings URL is preserved here without modifying the registry.
milestones.title: BIOT: Biosignal Transformer for Cross-Data Learning in the Wild
milestones.evidence_boundary: This is representation or predictive-model evidence. It does not by itself establish a causal treatment effect, clinical benefit, safety, or regulatory readiness.

milestones.label: SSL-Wearables
milestones.caption: Accelerometer pretraining on 700,000 person-days

source_checked.finding: Published 12 April 2024; self-supervised wrist-accelerometer pretraining on 700,000 person-days, evaluated across eight HAR datasets.

milestones.note_optional: Retain registry year 2024. A tri-axial accelerometer is one modality with several channels.
milestones.title: Self-Supervised Learning for Human Activity Recognition Using 700,000 Person-Days of Wearable Data
milestones.evidence_boundary: This is representation or predictive-model evidence. It does not by itself establish a causal treatment effect, clinical benefit, safety, or regulatory readiness.

milestones.label: LSM
milestones.caption: Scaling multimodal wearable representations

source_checked.finding: Initial preprint 17 October 2024; multimodal wearable foundation model and scaling analysis. Google Research publication listing now labels the conference publication 2025.

milestones.note_optional: Registry year 2024 matches the initial preprint and 20 November 2024 Google Research blog; official publication listing https://research.google/pubs/scaling-wearable-foundation-models/ uses 2025. Keep registry year visible and record the year basis outside the diagram.
milestones.title: Scaling Wearable Foundation Models
milestones.evidence_boundary: This is representation or predictive-model evidence. It does not by itself establish a causal treatment effect, clinical benefit, safety, or regulatory readiness.

milestones.label: SleepFM (ICML)
milestones.caption: Contrastive sleep learning across physiological modalities

source_checked.finding: ICML 2024; multimodal sleep pretraining with brain, ECG and respiratory signals, evaluated on sleep-related transfer tasks.

milestones.note_optional: Retain registry year 2024. Distinct registry paper from the 2026 disease-prediction article. PSG is clinical/body-sensed-adjacent rather than watch-only sensing.
milestones.title: SleepFM: Multi-modal Representation Learning for Sleep Across Brain Activity, ECG and Respiratory Signals
milestones.evidence_boundary: This record supports a representation, recognition, sensing or control-system claim under the reported evaluation. It does not by itself establish clinical benefit, causal treatment effect, safety, transportability or regulatory readiness.

milestones.label: PaPaGei
milestones.caption: Open PPG pretraining with morphology-aware learning

source_checked.finding: ICLR 2025; open PPG foundation models with morphology-aware representation learning and multi-dataset evaluation.

milestones.note_optional: Registry year 2025 is the conference year. Initial arXiv preprint https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.20542 appeared 27 October 2024. Registry OpenReview URL was inaccessible during checking; the official ICLR proceedings PDF was checked instead.
milestones.title: PaPaGei: Open Foundation Models for Optical Physiological Signals
milestones.evidence_boundary: This is representation or predictive-model evidence. It does not by itself establish a causal treatment effect, clinical benefit, safety, or regulatory readiness.

milestones.label: SensorLM
milestones.caption: Aligning wearable sensor sequences with language

source_checked.finding: NeurIPS 2025; sensor-language pretraining with hierarchical captions, zero-shot recognition and cross-modal retrieval evaluations.

milestones.note_optional: Retain registry year 2025. Language alignment is represented as a research category, not an inferred descendant of LSM.
milestones.title: SensorLM: Learning the Language of Wearable Sensors
milestones.evidence_boundary: This is representation or predictive-model evidence. It does not by itself establish a causal treatment effect, clinical benefit, safety, or regulatory readiness.

milestones.label: GluFormer
milestones.caption: Reusable representations from continuous glucose data

source_checked.finding: Nature version of record published 14 January 2026; self-supervised CGM pretraining yields representations evaluated across external cohorts.

milestones.note_optional: Retain registry year 2026; the 2025 component of the DOI is not the publication year. Caption avoids clinical-benefit or causal claims.
milestones.title: A Foundation Model for Continuous Glucose Monitoring Data
milestones.evidence_boundary: This is representation or predictive-model evidence. It does not by itself establish a causal treatment effect, clinical benefit, safety, or regulatory readiness.

milestones.label: SleepFM (clinical)
milestones.caption: Multimodal sleep representations for disease prediction

source_checked.finding: Nature Medicine published 6 January 2026; multimodal PSG pretraining and downstream future-disease prediction evaluations.

milestones.note_optional: Retain registry year 2026. This milestone represents the clinical prediction study; the 2024 ICML study has a distinct task focus. Disease prediction is not a clinical intervention effect.
milestones.title: A Multimodal Sleep Foundation Model for Disease Prediction
milestones.evidence_boundary: This is representation or predictive-model evidence. It does not by itself establish a causal treatment effect, clinical benefit, safety, or regulatory readiness.

milestones.label: SensorFM
milestones.caption: Wearable pretraining across five sensor modalities

source_checked.finding: Google Research official report dated 9 July 2026; missingness-aware pretraining on five wearable sensor modalities with transfer and agent-grounding evaluations.

milestones.note_optional: Retain registry year 2026. Technical-report evidence; do not depict clinical approval, causal benefit or model ancestry.
milestones.title: Towards a General Intelligence and Interface for Wearable Health Data
milestones.evidence_boundary: This is representation or predictive-model evidence. It does not by itself establish a causal treatment effect, clinical benefit, safety, or regulatory readiness.

milestones.label: Apple Heart Study
milestones.caption: Population-scale AF notification validation
milestones.note_optional: Primary source: https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa1901183 . Published 13 November 2019. Measures irregular-pulse notification yield and positive predictive value with subsequent ECG confirmation. Does not establish population sensitivity, stroke prevention, or net clinical benefit. Label is the study's own name.
milestones.title: Large-Scale Assessment of a Smartwatch to Identify Atrial Fibrillation
milestones.evidence_boundary: This supports analytical or clinical validation in the studied cohort and device setting; it does not establish universal cross-device validity or downstream clinical benefit.

milestones.label: COVID early detection
milestones.caption: Personal baselines flag presymptomatic physiological deviations
milestones.note_optional: Primary source: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41551-020-00640-6 . Published 18 November 2020. Editorial abbreviated display label, not a canonical model name. Analysis used retrospective smartwatch data and a small infected subgroup; it does not establish a clinically deployed diagnostic test or improved patient outcomes.
milestones.title: Pre-symptomatic Detection of COVID-19 from Smartwatch Data
milestones.evidence_boundary: This supports analytical or clinical validation in the studied cohort and device setting; it does not establish universal cross-device validity or downstream clinical benefit.

milestones.label: HbA1c change prediction
milestones.caption: Activity patterns improve HbA1c-change prediction
milestones.note_optional: Primary source: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41746-021-00541-1 . Published 21 December 2021. Editorial abbreviated display label. Prediction analysis nested within a trial assigning wearable placement; the study did not randomize model-guided treatment and does not demonstrate that prediction itself improves glycemic outcomes.
milestones.title: Predicting Changes in Glycemic Control among Adults with Prediabetes from Activity Patterns Collected by Wearable Devices
milestones.evidence_boundary: This supports analytical or clinical validation in the studied cohort and device setting; it does not establish universal cross-device validity or downstream clinical benefit.

milestones.label: PD-VME
milestones.caption: Repeated remote motor-function measurements
milestones.note_optional: Primary source: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41746-022-00607-8 . Published 23 May 2022. Source defines Parkinson's Disease Virtual Motor Exam (PD-VME). Validates unsupervised smartwatch motor measurements, repeatability, and medication sensitivity in early-stage Parkinson disease. Not a regulatory-qualified progression endpoint or evidence of disease-modifying benefit.
milestones.title: Virtual Exam for Parkinson’s Disease Enables Frequent and Reliable Remote Measurements of Motor Function
milestones.evidence_boundary: This supports analytical or clinical validation in the studied cohort and device setting; it does not establish universal cross-device validity or downstream clinical benefit.

milestones.label: CosinorAge
milestones.caption: Circadian rhythm biomarker of aging
milestones.note_optional: Primary source: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41746-024-01111-x . Published 4 June 2024. Canonical biomarker name. Links wearable-derived rhythms with aging-related outcomes, including external cohort analyses; associations do not show that modifying CosinorAge changes mortality or disease risk.
milestones.title: Circadian Rhythm Analysis Using Wearable-Based Accelerometry as a Digital Biomarker of Aging and Healthspan
milestones.evidence_boundary: The reported relationship is observational or predictive. It does not establish that changing the wearable-derived measure will causally change the clinical outcome.

milestones.label: Mood episode prediction
milestones.caption: Sleep rhythms predict next-day mood episodes
milestones.note_optional: Primary source: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41746-024-01333-z . Published 18 November 2024. Editorial abbreviated display label. Predictive models use personal sleep-wake histories and circadian features in 168 patients; prospective model-guided decision support or intervention benefit was not tested.
milestones.title: Accurately Predicting Mood Episodes in Mood Disorder Patients Using Wearable Sleep and Circadian Rhythm Features
milestones.evidence_boundary: This supports analytical or clinical validation in the studied cohort and device setting; it does not establish universal cross-device validity or downstream clinical benefit.

milestones.label: WEAR-ME / IR prediction
milestones.caption: Wearables and biomarkers estimate insulin resistance
milestones.note_optional: Primary source: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-026-10179-2 . Published 16 March 2026. WEAR-ME is the source's study name; the combined label is editorial and refers to registry short_name IR-Prediction. Estimates HOMA-IR-defined insulin resistance using wearable data, demographics, and blood biomarkers, with independent validation. This is not prediction of future diabetes incidence, nor proof of treatment benefit.
milestones.title: Insulin Resistance Prediction from Wearables and Routine Blood Biomarkers
milestones.evidence_boundary: This is representation or predictive-model evidence. It does not by itself establish a causal treatment effect, clinical benefit, safety, or regulatory readiness.

milestones.label: Longitudinal rhythm aging
milestones.caption: Multi-year activity rhythms and aging trajectories
milestones.note_optional: Primary source: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-026-76147-6 . First published 22 August 2026 (before the registry cutoff of 2 September 2026); publisher now lists version of record 24 September 2026. Editorial abbreviated display label, not a canonical model name. Fitbit rest-activity rhythms are associated with clinical biomarker-derived biological aging trajectories; observational evidence is not causal validation.
milestones.title: Longitudinal Digital Phenotyping of Activity Rhythms and Biological Aging Using Commercial Wearables
milestones.evidence_boundary: The reported relationship is observational or predictive. It does not establish that changing the wearable-derived measure will causally change the clinical outcome.

milestones.label: Micro-randomized trials
milestones.caption: Repeated randomization for timely interventions
milestones.note_optional: 2015 issue and DOI confirmed at https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/26651463/. An experimental design for optimizing JITAI components; not itself an effective intervention or learned policy.
milestones.title: Microrandomized Trials: An Experimental Design for Developing Just-in-Time Adaptive Interventions
milestones.evidence_boundary: Micro-randomized evidence identifies randomized component effects at specified decision points, not the effectiveness of an untested full intervention package.

milestones.label: Home artificial beta cell
milestones.caption: Home closed-loop insulin-delivery trial
milestones.note_optional: 2015 publication and study checked at https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4697362/ and https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/26379095/. CGM-driven insulin delivery evaluated in home-use crossover studies; publication year is not the invention date.
milestones.title: Home Use of an Artificial Beta Cell in Type 1 Diabetes
milestones.evidence_boundary: Randomization supports the specified trial estimand, but it does not validate every algorithmic component, subgroup policy or future deployment configuration.

milestones.label: IDEA trial
milestones.caption: Less weight loss with tracker add-on
milestones.note_optional: 2016 randomized trial checked at https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5480209/. This specific 24-month lifestyle trial found less weight loss in the technology-enhanced group; it does not show that all activity trackers are ineffective.
milestones.title: Effect of Wearable Technology Combined With a Lifestyle Intervention on Long-term Weight Loss: The IDEA Randomized Clinical Trial
milestones.evidence_boundary: Randomization supports the specified trial estimand, but it does not validate every algorithmic component, subgroup policy or future deployment configuration.

milestones.label: Mobile-health effect moderation
milestones.caption: Time-varying effect estimation in mobile health
milestones.note_optional: Primary manuscript checked at https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6241330/. Registry year 2018 is the JASA issue year; online publication was 2017-03-29. Centered and weighted estimation with a BASICS-Mobile illustration; a mobile-health method rather than a wearable-native model.
milestones.title: Assessing Time-Varying Causal Effect Moderation in Mobile Health
milestones.venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association
milestones.evidence_boundary: Micro-randomized evidence identifies randomized component effects at specified decision points, not the effectiveness of an untested full intervention package.

milestones.label: HeartSteps MRT
milestones.caption: Context-tailored activity suggestions; six-week trial
milestones.note_optional: Primary report checked at https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6401341/; 2019 issue confirmed at https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30192907/. The registry lists this trial report as a method. Walking-suggestion effects weakened over time, and antisedentary suggestions had no detectable proximal step effect; do not call this an RL policy study.
milestones.title: Efficacy of Contextually Tailored Suggestions for Physical Activity: A Micro-Randomized Optimization Trial of HeartSteps
milestones.evidence_boundary: Micro-randomized evidence identifies randomized component effects at specified decision points, not the effectiveness of an untested full intervention package.

milestones.label: MyCoach / SmartText
milestones.caption: Pilot trial of Fitbit-informed coaching
milestones.note_optional: 2021 date and intervention checked at https://www.nature.com/articles/s41746-021-00539-9. Three-arm, four-week trial in 42 cancer survivors with Fitbit-derived steps. Voice-coaching findings should not be generalized to all AI coaching or long-term health outcomes.
milestones.title: Randomized Trial of Two Artificial Intelligence Coaching Interventions to Increase Physical Activity in Cancer Survivors
milestones.evidence_boundary: The reported effect is tied to the randomized intervention, comparator, population, follow-up and endpoint; it should not be generalized to other devices or care pathways without new evidence.

milestones.label: CREATE open-source AID
milestones.caption: Randomized trial of open-source insulin control
milestones.note_optional: 2022 trial confirmed at https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36069869/ and the primary author-institution copy https://ourarchive.otago.ac.nz/esploro/outputs/journalArticle/Open-Source-Automated-Insulin-Delivery-in-Type/9926495492901891. Evaluated a modified AndroidAPS/OpenAPS system in children and adults; not evidence for every open-source system configuration.
milestones.title: Open-Source Automated Insulin Delivery in Type 1 Diabetes
milestones.evidence_boundary: Randomization supports the specified trial estimand, but it does not validate every algorithmic component, subgroup policy or future deployment configuration.

milestones.label: Brain-spine interface
milestones.caption: Single-participant implanted brain-to-spine control
milestones.note_optional: 2023 study checked at https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10232367/. Fully implanted recording/stimulation linked cortical decoding to spinal stimulation in one participant. Display as implantable-adjacent, not as a noninvasive wearable or population-level efficacy trial.
milestones.title: Walking Naturally after Spinal Cord Injury Using a Brain-Spine Interface
milestones.evidence_boundary: Randomization supports the specified trial estimand, but it does not validate every algorithmic component, subgroup policy or future deployment configuration.

milestones.label: ADD MALTS
milestones.caption: Distributional treatment effects from wearable outcomes
milestones.note_optional: 2024 AISTATS paper checked at https://proceedings.mlr.press/v238/katta24a.html. Matching for treatment-effect estimation with distribution-valued wearable/sensor outcomes, including a CGM application; validity depends on the causal identification assumptions.
milestones.title: Interpretable Causal Inference for Analyzing Wearable, Sensor, and Distributional Data
milestones.evidence_boundary: This record supports causal methodology. It does not prove that any particular wearable-derived exposure or intervention has a causal effect without a design-specific analysis.

milestones.label: InTandem
milestones.caption: Adaptive music tested in stroke rehabilitation
milestones.note_optional: 2024 randomized trial checked at https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-024-44791-5. Real-time gait sensing controls individualized auditory rhythm. Five-week post-stroke trial; long-term durability and other patient populations were not established.
milestones.title: Efficacy and Safety of Using Auditory-Motor Entrainment to Improve Walking after Stroke: A Multi-Site Randomized Controlled Trial of InTandem
milestones.evidence_boundary: The reported effect is tied to the randomized intervention, comparator, population, follow-up and endpoint; it should not be generalized to other devices or care pathways without new evidence.

milestones.label: myBPmyLife
milestones.caption: Activity gains without additional BP reduction
milestones.note_optional: 2025 result report checked at https://www.nature.com/articles/s41746-025-01844-3. In 602 randomized participants, step count and sodium intake improved relative to control, but the six-month systolic blood-pressure primary endpoint did not. Do not substitute the 2024 rationale/protocol for the 2025 result report.
milestones.title: Physical Activity and Diet Just-in-Time Adaptive Intervention to Reduce Blood Pressure: A Randomized Controlled Trial
milestones.evidence_boundary: Randomization supports the specified trial estimand, but it does not validate every algorithmic component, subgroup policy or future deployment configuration.

milestones.label: JITAI design synthesis
milestones.caption: Review of adaptive intervention design
milestones.note_optional: Primary review checked at https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13217361/ and https://www.annualreviews.org/doi/pdf/10.1146/annurev-psych-121024-044244. Registry year 2026 is the Annual Review of Psychology volume year; first online as a Review in Advance on 2025-09-12. This is a synthesis, not a new algorithm or clinical efficacy trial.
milestones.title: Just-in-Time Adaptive Interventions: Where Are We Now and What Is Next?
milestones.evidence_boundary: Micro-randomized evidence identifies randomized component effects at specified decision points, not the effectiveness of an untested full intervention package.
